text:
Priya: Heads-up for evening handoff — quick notes before I sign off.
- Deployed small batching tweak to canary pool (canary-dedicated-01) at 18:15 PT. CPU/GPU and latency looked fine during canary (p50 +8ms), but KV hit-rate dropped ~3% for long-tail requests.
- Watch: minor uptick in KV evictions on hosts g4-*/pool-2, likely due to increased prefix caching by client A. If you see auth errors, restart the cache process.
- Action items: @Alex can you watch logs for `kv_eviction` metric and abort roll if p99 latency rises > 200ms? @Tara please verify canary logs for quantization mismatch (see snippet).
- No paging oncall escalation right now; this is FYI and can be handled in-shift.

Alex: Ack. I'll set a short alert rule and ping if thresholds cross. Running:
```
kubectl logs -f inference-canary --since=15m | grep kv_eviction
```
Also posting a quick dashboard link: https://console.redwood/metrics/canary-dedicated-01

Liam: One more data point — earlier today we had one failed model swap in eu-west during warmup (PR #289). I've rolled back the swap to v2.1.2 and opened a follow-up task. Not seeing client impact. @Priya can you drop the PR link in the thread?

Priya: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/289 — root cause is an unexpected dtype cast in the compiler path. I've left a note for research to validate quantized kernels before rollout.

Tara: Checked canary logs for quant mismatch. Found small warnings around `cast_to_int8` in 18:22-18:25 window, but no errors. I'll run a quick recompile on a dev node and report results by 19:00 PT.

ops-bot: Deploy canary-dedicated-01: success (18:15 PT). Canary health: healthy. Alerts suppressed for 10m.

Alex: Created temporary scalar alert:
- metric: infererence.kv_eviction_rate
- scope: canary-dedicated-01
- trigger: p99 latency > 200ms OR kv_eviction_rate > 0.05 for 3m
Will escalate to oncall if fired.

Priya: FYI for next shift — if you see `auth: token refresh failed` logs after 18:30, kill and let system restore the cache process:
`systemctl restart redwood-cache && sleep 30 && kubectl rollout status ds/cache -n infra`
That's safe.

Liam: Status check: rolling rollback completed for eu-west swap. No user-facing errors in the last 45m.

Tara: Update from recompile: no reproductions locally. Pushing a small logging PR to get more detail on `cast_to_int8` path. ETA for PR merge: tomorrow morning.

Priya: Leaving notes on the handoff doc: https://confluence.redwood/handovers/2026-03-18-evening-handoff
Main takeaways:
- Watch kv_eviction metric on canary pools (Alex)
- Do not escalate unless p99 latency > 200ms or >5% eviction rate (policy)
- Follow-up: logging PR from Tara, model kernel validation ticket for research (assigned)

Alex: Got it. I'll take the nightwatch. Ping me directly for anything urgent. :raised_hands:

Tara: Thanks — will ping if PR surfaces anything.

Priya: Thanks team, signing off. :wave:
